plan.notes: Transfer track approved under ACT 182 of 2009 (Roger Phillips Transfer Act). Source states Total Credit Hours Required: 60-62; sequenced sum is 62 (term totals 15/16/16/15 verified against source Term Totals), i.e. the top of the stated range; Directed GE electives 18-24 and Approved electives 0-7 account for the range. 'Development Psychology' kept verbatim from source (listed as PSYC 21003 Development Psychology). Embedded Certificate of General Studies is a flat unordered checklist with no term sequence, so it is an honest negative, not a separate seed. Curriculum Approved: March 2026; Updated: 06/03/2026. ACTS numbers taken from the source's own ACTS column for exactly matching course codes only.
